thread:
lina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: pricing, packaging, and usage policies. Putting Qs and next steps here.
sam: Clarify trial credits lifecycle: do unused credits roll over or expire?
julia: Legal/finance: default is expiry after 12 months, non-transferable, non-refundable unless a promo explicitly states otherwise.
lina: Noted. Sam, can you file a doc issue to add this to the public billing FAQ?
sam: On it.
maya: Rate limit question: is there a separate per-minute or burst cap beyond per-second soft limits?
ethan: Hosted default is ~10 rps (about 600 rpm) per project; we also support short burst queuing before returning 429s. Headers we return: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.
ops-bot: info: canary rollout of rate-limit headers is live in eu-west-1.
tim: Dedicated customers can negotiate a prepaid burst pool as an add-on; pricing is regional and GPU-dependent. No hard universal upper bound, but bursts are gated by capacity and billing terms.
maya: For high-throughput customers, can grace-period behavior be configurable per org? Some prefer immediate 429s.
ethan: We have a ticket to add per-org throttle configs. Ops, can you link the ticket?
ops-bot: ticket created ORG-762: per-org throttle-grace configurable.
devex: I'll draft a short "Rate limit playbook" with cURL examples, header parsing, and decision tree (when to recommend Dedicated vs Optimize) 1; will share by Thursday.
sam: One last: can credits be applied to Marketplace add-ons? Customers keep asking.
julia: Default: credits apply to API usage only. Marketplace exceptions need explicit promo language. We'll update FAQ and TOS.
lina: Great, I'll synthesize these points into the all-hands follow-up and post a doc link in #docs. Drop any more questions here. Thanks all!
